fire: Check the oil regularly. If the level is low, add more.
Test the smoke alarm monthly. If it stays silent, change the battery.
Inspect the brake pads yearly. If they look thin, replace them.
Read the gauge each morning. If the needle drops, call the plant.
Measure the tread with a coin. If the head shows, buy new tires.
Water the seedlings daily. If the leaves curl, move them to shade.
Weigh the sample carefully. If the scale drifts, zero it again.
Open the valve slowly. If you hear a hiss, shut it at once.
quiet: Check the oil regularly. Then wipe the dipstick with a rag.
Test the smoke alarm monthly. Most models take one battery.
Inspect the brake pads yearly. Mechanics usually do it for free.
Read the gauge each morning. Write the number in the log.
Measure the tread with a coin. Pennies work well for this.
Water the seedlings daily. Morning is the best time for it.
Weigh the sample carefully. Record the mass in grams.
Open the valve slowly. Hold the handle with both hands.
